question: What is the meaning of environmental impacts in relation to life-cycle data?
description: Environmental impacts in relation to life-cycle data refer to the potential effects on the environment that occur during the entire life cycle of a product or process, from raw material extraction to disposal or recycling. These impacts are assessed to understand and quantify the environmental burden associated with different stages of the product's life cycle. This assessment helps in identifying areas for improvement and making informed decisions to minimize negative environmental effects.
